key.name: neon-enabled
key.description: Show the neon shape overlay on the desktop background

key.name: neon-shape
key.description: 0: up-triangle, 1: down-triangle, 2: circle, 3: hexagon, 4: horizontal rectangle, 5: square, 6: vertical rectangle, 7: diamond

key.name: neon-color
key.description: Neon tube, dust, and rain color (e.g. #00ffcc)

key.name: underglow
key.description: Neon glow around normal windows, plus GTK decoration shadows (restart apps for the latter)

key.name: music-reactive
key.description: React to system audio with multi-band neon effects

key.name: reverse-rain
key.description: Make the neon rain fall upward instead of downward

key.name: keep-awake
key.description: Prevent the screen from blanking while music visualization is active
